integration.order: Immediately after decode_sketches; merge additional_geometry byowner/id, mergepatterns into constraints byowner/id, add tool_constraints.decoded summaries and remove only matching successful controller unresolved. Remove unsupported_curves only for returned additionalgeometry IDs. Then text/coverage/details/profiles/placement run.
integration.additional_geometry: Nine across original five: five generated ellipses with absent axis-line refs; four patterned FittedSpline entities including seed. No reclassification of Circle sharing Arc native class.
integration.shared_hook: decode_sketch_pattern(...,*,member_kinds=(Line,Circle),dependency_extras=None); defaults exact; opt-in records native_dependency_slots raw.
integration.clearing_limits: Do not remove unrelated unknown constraints or unsupported dimensions.

evidence.pattern_framing: Existing common reader validates owner, parameter bindings/caches, native kind code, counted dependency/role lists, exact seed/genesis prefix, ordered instance groups and member kinds.
evidence.identities: Seed/created/source association IDs come from native ordered roles, not nearest coordinates or geometric matching. API geometry/order compares the already assigned native IDs.
evidence.ellipse_missing_axes: Generated ellipse residual172 vs source192; two absent one-byte axis refs replace two11-byte refs. API majorAxisLine/minorAxisLine absent; explicit center/owner and geometry remain.
evidence.ellipse_dependency_tag: Both circular and rectangular source Ellipse slots have rawextra4, createdslots0. Only typed seedEllipse mapping permits4; meaning remains unknown.
evidence.spline: Existing split NURBS reader decodes FF8 primary174 + continuation + explicit fitpoint collection despite patterned genesis130/128 outerfilter. Retry actualgetData confirms degree5,20controlpoints,26knots,20unitweights,rationalTrue,periodicFalse for all4curves.
evidence.retry_reason: Original exports and actualfitpoints remained valid; original geometry.getData serialization failed on SWIG Point3DVector. Serializer fixed, one-case retry has no getter failures.

limitations: Only single curved seeds, unsuppressed/default directions captured
Circle/Arc shared class distinguished by validated decodedkind
No solver, constraint inference, regenerated geometry or coordinate-derived IDs
